lines.zh: 我贴着墙角挪，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I slide along the wall, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的房子走外圈。
lines.en: I walk the outer ring of your house.

lines.zh: 脚掌落得很慢，怕被听见。
lines.en: My feet come down slowly so you won't hear.

lines.zh: 我沿着屋檐下的阴影前行。
lines.en: I travel the shade beneath the eaves.

lines.zh: 草被我压下去，但没有响。
lines.en: The grass bends under me and makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我爬上墙，一步一步往上。
lines.en: I climb the wall, one hold at a time.
I slip over the low wall and land softly.

lines.zh: 我在门口停了半息，又走开。
lines.en: I pause at the door for half a breath, then move on.

lines.zh: 我从窗下经过，没往里看。
lines.en: I pass beneath the window and don't look in.

lines.zh: 我在地上留了两道浅浅的印。
lines.en: Two shallow prints follow me on the ground.
I work my way around to your back.
I stop in the dark and don't move.
Only my eyes move.
I tilt my head and listen to you breathe.

lines.zh: 墙那边有脚步声，我听着。
lines.en: There are footsteps beyond the wall; I listen.

lines.zh: 我的手指在地上轻轻划。
lines.en: My fingers draw lightly on the floor.

lines.zh: 我不出声，这比喊更有用。
lines.en: I make no sound; it works better than shouting.

lines.zh: 光从缝里漏进来，我避开。
lines.en: Light leaks through a gap and I avoid it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到人的味道。
lines.en: I raise my head and catch a human smell.
I wait for you to come closer on your own.
Half my head shows around the corner.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，你还没看见我。
lines.en: I see you; you haven't seen me.
I watch like this, without a sound.
You turn, and I pull back.

lines.zh: 你的手电光扫过来，我低头。
lines.en: Your light sweeps past and I duck.

lines.zh: 你一停下，我就往前一点。
lines.en: When you stop, I edge forward.
Only one wall stands between us.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，你不会听见。
lines.en: My breathing is slow; you won't hear it.

lines.zh: 我想知道你会不会尖叫。
lines.en: I want to know whether you'll scream.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头抬高，让你看见。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly so you see me.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，然后开始叫。
lines.en: I smile, and then I begin to scream.
Don't run; running excites me more.
I fall back behind the wall, clutching the wound.
I cry out and the sound catches.
The blow doubles me over.
My breathing turns fast and ugly.
My movements lag half a beat.
I lean on the wall to steady.
I look at my hand; it's shaking.
Blood drips to the floor, very softly.
I retreat, but not far.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛还盯着你。
lines.en: I look up, eyes still fixed on you.
I don't eat that.
I walk around it without sniffing.
You hold it out as if begging me.
It's not food I'm after.

lines.zh: 它落在土里，我看都不看。
lines.en: It drops in the dirt and I don't look.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，把它拨开。
lines.en: I push it aside with one finger.

lines.zh: 我更想要你手里的别的东西。
lines.en: I'd rather have something else you carry.
You keep holding it up; it annoys me.
I step on it and crush it.
This smell reminds me of the surface.
You hit me and I barely shift.
I let the force carry me behind the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下让我发出很短的一声。
lines.en: The bump draws a short sound from me.
I brace a hand on the wall and steady.
I didn't dodge when you came at me.
I tilt my head and watch you back off.

lines.zh: 尘土在我们之间翻起来。
lines.en: Dust rolls between us.
I slide half a step along the wall.
You're softer than I expected.

lines.zh: 我站定了，等你再撞一次。
lines.en: I settle and wait for you to try again.
We converge from two directions.

lines.zh: 她也不出声，只是看着我。
lines.en: She makes no sound either; she only looks.
We draw apart, then near again.
Her eyes are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在黑暗里交换位置。
lines.en: We trade places in the dark.
She reaches out and I go still.

lines.zh: 这段寂静里，只有我们两个。
lines.en: In this silence there are only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我跟在她后面，走她走过的路。
lines.en: I follow behind, walking where she walked.

lines.zh: 她一转头，我们就对上了。
lines.en: She turns her head and we meet.

lines.zh: 然后我们各自散进暗处。
lines.en: Then we each fade back into the dark.
I pick it up and hold it.
I tuck it into a gap and hide it.

lines.zh: 这东西有点重量，我喜欢。
lines.en: It has some weight; I like that.
I bite it once — wrong taste.

lines.zh: 我把它扔回去，声音很响。
lines.en: I throw it back, and it lands loudly.
I carry it and walk away slowly.
I flatten it with my palm.
Now it smells of me.
I put it in my mouth and chew slowly.
I'll keep it; it may be useful.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就开始了。
lines.en: You've seen me; then it's begun.
My head turns toward you slowly.
I open my mouth without a sound.
I rise from behind my cover.

lines.zh: 你的位置在光里，太容易了。
lines.en: You stand in the light; too easy.
This scream will carry a long way.
My limbs snap taut.
I stop looking anywhere else.

lines.zh: 你跑的那一下，我等很久了。
lines.en: I've waited a long time for you to run.

lines.zh: 从这一步起，你甩不掉我。
lines.en: From this step, you won't shake me.
I start a low sound.
Walls won't stop me; you should know that.
I grip the seams and climb.

lines.zh: 你退到门边，我走得更快。
lines.en: You back to the door and I move faster.
I know these rooms well.
I've screamed; now you should run.
You're upstairs; I can tell.
You shut the door; I come through the window.
I cross the ridge and gravel shifts.
You stop at the corner; so do I.
Your breathing is getting louder.
I've put the light out.
You're running, and running badly.
I cling to the wall and keep pace.

lines.zh: 这栋房子只有一个出口。
lines.en: This house has one way out.
I'll wait at the door.
You heard that, didn't you? That was me.
I don't need speed, only accuracy.

lines.zh: 前面已经是死路，只剩一堵墙。
lines.en: The way ahead is a dead end, just a wall.

lines.zh: 你转身时我已经贴上来。
lines.en: When you turn, I'm already close.
One last stretch — don't trip.
I'm an arm's length from you.
I've got you; stop squirming.
I reach out and take your shoulder.
The grab tears your sleeve.
I drop low and ram into you.
You're knocked into the wall.
My hand comes up, nails first.
I press my whole body over you.
You get one arm free.
My voice is right at your ear.

lines.zh: 我拽住你的脚踝往回拖。
lines.en: I catch your ankle and drag you back.
That one makes you cry out.

lines.zh: 我把你按住，不急着结束。
lines.en: I pin you and don't hurry to finish.

lines.zh: 你打在我脸上，我歪了歪头。
lines.en: You hit my face and my head tilts.
I tear a piece loose and hold it.
I pull back and lunge again.

lines.zh: 你爬到门口，我把门关上。
lines.en: You reach the door; I close it.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过木板，声音很长。
lines.en: Nails rake the boards with a long sound.
You're weaker than I expected.

lines.zh: 我又叫了一声，就在你脸前。
lines.en: I scream again, right in your face.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，你就不动了。
lines.en: After this, you stop moving.

lines.zh: 我在墙后出现，先没有脸。
lines.en: I appear behind the wall, faceless at first.
First I learn how to stand.

lines.zh: 暗处有一双眼睛睁开了。
lines.en: A pair of eyes opens in the dark.
I try out a small sound.
This room is too empty.
I grow up out of the corner.
The floor creaks; it's me.
I straighten up slowly.
It's dark outside — good.
I turn my head toward the door.

lines.zh: 我记住了这栋房子的样子。
lines.en: I've learned the shape of this house.
My first step is very light.
The lamp goes out, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的皮肤，我扭身躲开。
lines.en: Fire sears my skin and I twist away.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，骨头在响。
lines.en: I hit the floor hard and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我抓着岸边爬。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I claw at the bank.

lines.zh: 一根杆子扎进来，我拔掉它。
lines.en: A shaft lodges in me; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 光一照，我整个人僵住了。
lines.en: The light hits and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我的腿发软。
lines.en: Too long without food; my legs go weak.
Lightning flashes and I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我一直在落。
lines.en: Nothing below me; I keep falling.
